content.text: No restrictive covenant binding AP appears anywhere; the agreement affirmatively disclaims exclusivity.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for non-compete, competing products, exclusivity, field-of-use and prohibitory language ("shall not", "agrees not to", "restrict", "solicit") return no covenant binding the Customer. To the contrary, Section 1 expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms the Agreement will not restrict AP from offering or selling Inventory through other agents or third parties, which matches our preferred position of no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer. The remaining "shall not" provisions bind Kubient (IP warranties) or are mutual/neutral terms, and the content-standards undertaking in p0041 is a compliance obligation rather than a restraint on our business. No redline required.
